subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “Phones were allowed on Fridays only.”?
options: The rule did not make everyone happy, but it helped students remember that free time can be shared, not only scrolled.
The village kept the well to remember a time when water had to be carried and community was built one bucket at a time.
The ancient recipe did not make the past fully return, but it helped visitors imagine ordinary people sitting down to a meal thousands of years before them.
They are kept because they help people remember what time has taken away.
